title: Ballistix-instantdetonate
description: A simple addon that makes every Ballistix explosive explode instantly.
body:
# Ballistix Instant Detonate

Ballistix Instant Detonate removes fuse timers from all Ballistix explosives, causing them to detonate immediately upon activation.

This is especially useful for creating physics-based ICBMs, missiles, and other high-speed explosive contraptions where delayed explosions would normally interfere with collisions.

## Features

- Removes fuse delays from all Ballistix explosives
- Lightweight and performance-friendly
- Ideal for high-speed missile and artillery systems

## Compatibility

- Requires Ballistix
- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge

## Notes

This mod has been developed for the "Minecraft Beyond the Horizons" modpack, which is currently in development.

This mod has only been tested on Minecraft 1.21.1 with NeoForge, but it may also work on other versions.

The mod only changes explosion timing. It does not modify explosive strength, blast radius, damage behavior, or add any physics engines.
